integrity: The proof is reconstructed from the published degree-three cellular basis and braid-generator formula. The packaged checker independently implements that formula, verifies braid relations, constructs the standard pure generators, and checks the predicted relation and rank through \(n=8\).
scientific_limitations: The exact image theorem is specific to the degree-three finite subset-space representation. The finite checker covers \(2\le n\le8\) and is supplementary to the all-parameter proof. Literature search cannot exclude every obscure or unindexed equivalent computation.
title: Exact pure-braid image on \(H_3(\exp_3 D_n;\mathbb Z)\)
